lines: His usage hasn't changed: he saw 4.0 targets per game over his last 3 games, same as the season, and played 64% of snaps.
Production fell off even though the targets didn't. He averaged 2.7 PPR points per game over his last 3, against 8.2 for the season.
Week 11 is against MIA, which allows the 30th-most PPR points per game to WRs. The coach said he'll keep getting opportunities and be moved around.
